answer: Proposal: one credential per human per epoch, granted at simultaneous physical events. All sessions run the same hour at distant venues with witnessed, cross-signed rolls, so no name can echo in a second roll that hour — physics, not face-matching, is the check — and a sybil cannot split like light through a prism: k credentials need k bodies at once. Phantoms minted by colluding witnesses sink into karst and resurface under audit, missing co-attendee signatures. Assumes rotating witnesses; reward per credential must stay below a hired body's wage, or renting crowds pays.
